controls: named insert-select projection attributes only its keys
positional insert-select makes the table opaque
raw INSERT attributes only the exact target table and named columns
SELECT mentions do not become writes
other-table INSERT columns do not become writes
INSERT text inside SQL strings or comments does not become a write
similarly named sqlFake tag does not become SQL evidence
double-quoted static table and column identifiers are supported
remaining_limits: Raw SQL reads remain table-agnostic and advisory through raw?.
Dynamic raw-SQL table or destination-column identity is not guessed.
Backtick-quoted and square-bracket-quoted SQL identifiers are not attributed by the raw INSERT reader; current production findings use unquoted identifiers.
